name: Measurement and logging while drilling (MWD/LWD)
principle: Sensors in the bottom-hole assembly measure well direction (MWD) and formation properties (LWD) while drilling and send data to the surface, usually by mud pulses, for real-time geosteering. LWD measurements include gamma ray, resistivity, density, neutron porosity, sonic, NMR, images and formation testing.

process_steps.name: Transmit by mud pulse or store in memory
Geosteer to stay in the target zone

advantages: Real-time placement in variable shale reservoirs
limitations: The Wikipedia page gives no mud-pulse data rates
